title: Moderation and admin authorization contract
description: Request/response shapes for the admin-domain callables (admin.setAdminRole, admin.suspendUser, admin.restoreAccess) and the serialized forms of the backend-written moderationActions/{actionId} and adminAuditEvents/{eventId} Firestore records. All records are written exclusively by the Admin SDK — Security Rules deny every client write, including from admins, so audit history can never be forged, altered, or deleted from a client. Custom claims (admin, suspended, activeMember) are set exclusively by these callables and propagate to clients on the next ID-token refresh (up to 1 hour; the backend revokes refresh tokens on suspension and admin revocation).

moderationReason.description: Human-readable justification recorded on every moderation and role-change action. Required — audit records must always carry a reason.

moderationActionType.description: Moderation action vocabulary carried over from packages/shared/src/users.ts. Phase 8 emits permanent_suspension (admin.suspendUser) and restore_access (admin.restoreAccess); the remaining values are reserved for later moderation features.

setAdminRoleRequest.description: Input for admin.setAdminRole. Callers can never target themselves, and owner accounts are never modified by this callable.

admin.description: true grants the admin custom claim and sets users/{uid}.role to 'admin'; false revokes the claim and sets the role to 'user'.

moderationRequest.description: Input for admin.suspendUser and admin.restoreAccess. Actors can never moderate themselves; admins cannot moderate owner accounts (only owners can).

moderationStatusResponse.description: Response of admin.suspendUser / admin.restoreAccess reflecting the new backend-managed suspension state.

moderationActionRecord.description: Serialized form of moderationActions/{actionId} — an immutable, backend-written moderation record. Admin-only read; no client writes.

expiresAt.description: Reserved for temporary suspensions; always null in Phase 8 (no automatic expiry — access is restored explicitly via admin.restoreAccess).

adminAuditEventRecord.description: Serialized form of adminAuditEvents/{eventId} — an immutable, backend-written audit record for every admin action (docs/firebase-data-model.md). Admin-only read; no client writes.

details.description: Optional safe summary of the change (never tokens, credentials, or PII).
